title: Block sizes in the block sets conjecture

publication.date_evidence: Received/accepted on published page 1; online publication in publisher-deposited Crossref metadata.

page_map.scope: Introduction, definitions, Conjecture 1 and binary-template input
Generalized obstruction, substitution and geometric scaling remark

findings.source: Definitions and positive degree convention, published p. 2
findings.content: Templates and blocks are explicitly nonempty. The degree is common block size, whereas LRW2012 uses total active size. Empty blocks would invalidate the lower bound.

findings.source: Introduction, published p. 3 and arXiv v1 p. 3
findings.content: The informal every-coloring phrase is false literally; Theorem 2 constructs one obstructing coloring of all finite words.
Two printed d−1 bounds are replaced by d. Whole-block contribution equality and distinct nonzero support are proved, including interlacing and d=1.

findings.kind: False overgeneralization; sufficient repaired theorem proved
findings.content: The source condition q≥p²d also needs p≥d for this obstruction. The unrestricted statement is contradicted by p=1,d=2,q=4 and the proved degree-two 12 3^q theorem.
Both versions define χ as the words of length 2k+2 with k+1 1's and k+1 2's, yet both list 1221211 for k=2, although it has seven letters; 122121 is a valid six-letter example.

findings.source: Published p. 6 and reminder p. 7; arXiv v1 p. 7
findings.content: The 12 3^q extension is proved using a homogeneous set of size 2k+2+2q and all palindromic substitutions.

findings.kind: Missing geometric extraction supplied as a separate compilation lemma
findings.content: The repeated-letter rigidity lemma is proved relative to the exact m=3 LRW lemma; scale squared equals block size. The Ramsey assertion uses the proved one-exceptional-letter family, not a transitive-set conjecture.

findings.kind: Published and preprint assertion refuted by complete counterexample
findings.content: For the regular unit hexagon X and every n≥1, the six row-value counts modulo 3 color 2^(−1/2)X^n without a monochromatic X. Finite affine extension, three-direction quadratic rigidity and the exactly-two-row histogram contradiction are proved. Thus the fixed √2 product claim, both regular and general, is false; Theorems 2 and 3 are unaffected.
The stated interior angle changes from 60 degrees in v1 to 120 degrees in the publication. This fixes the angle description, not the product assertion.
λ_i entries of each of +i and −i with sum iλ_i=d have support 2 sum λ_i and one-norm 2d, not in general support 2d.
Frankl–Rödl1990 is JAMS3,1–7, not136,119–127. LRW cyclic quadrilaterals is J.Comb.2(2011),457–462, not the printed2017,459–462.

Questions5–6 require positive integer lengths and disjoint supports; the coefficient radius r corresponds to ambient one-norm radius rd. The cited real cyclic kite has transcendental a in (−1,1). These remain dated source questions.
